hero.title: Test Your Relationship: The Quiz for Two
hero.description: 20 questions to discover your compatibility level. Take turns and see if you're truly on the same wavelength!

seo.card1Text: Discover your common ground and better understand the differences that enrich your relationship.
seo.card2Text: Every question is an opportunity for discussion and sharing with your partner.
seo.card3Text: Your score helps you see where you can grow together and which aspects of your relationship deserve attention.
seo.card4Text: Beyond the score, it's a playful and intimate moment to share as a couple.
seo.step1Text: Enter the names and genders of both players
seo.step2Text: For each question, player 1 answers first, then player 2
seo.step3Text: The more identical answers you have, the higher your score!
seo.faq1Q: Is the couple test really free?
seo.faq1A: Yes, our couple test is 100% free and requires no registration. You can take it as many times as you like.
seo.faq2Q: How long does the test take?
seo.faq2A: The test takes about 5 minutes. It includes 20 questions that both partners answer in turns.
seo.faq3A: The score is based on the number of identical answers between both partners. The more you answer the same, the higher your compatibility score!
